theme_central: Mirror structure: faith in Allah (opening) answers faith in the Messenger (closing); between the two, the call to charitable spending frames the light of the believers contrasted with the darkness of the hypocrites.
sources_note: 5-passage mirror structure precisely sourced (islam21c.com, The Beauty of Iron): 1-6, 7-11, 12-15, passage 4 mirroring passage 2, 25-29.

branches.title: Allah's magnificence
branches.resume: Everything glorifies Him, perfect knowledge encompassing all that enters the earth and all that comes out of it.

children.t: Allah's magnificence, perfect knowledge of everything

branches.title: Faith and the call to spend
branches.resume: Believing in Allah and His messenger, spending from what He has entrusted to you.

children.t: Call to believe and to spend in Allah's path

branches.title: Light vs darkness
branches.resume: The light of the believers moving ahead of them, contrasted with the darkness of the hypocrites.

children.t: Light of the believers opposed to the darkness of the hypocrites at the Judgment

branches.title: The hardening heart
branches.resume: Is it not time for hearts to humble themselves at Allah's reminder? Warning against hardness of heart.

children.t: Warning against the heart hardening over time

branches.title: Parable of the rain, greed
branches.resume: This worldly life compared to rain that makes things grow then dries up; condemnation of greed.

children.t: Worldly life compared to rain, condemnation of greed

branches.title: The Book, the Balance, Iron
branches.resume: Messengers sent with the Book, the Balance and Iron to establish justice; closing on faith in the Messenger.

children.t: Book, Balance and Iron sent to establish universal justice
